#.label: Adyen cloud terminals (preview)
#/properties/terminalId.label: Terminal ID
#/properties/terminalId.description: Adyen's ID for the terminal at this checkout, for example e285p-123456789. Each checkout has its own terminal, so set this on one checkout. A value set higher up applies to every checkout below it.
#/properties/transactionRouting.label: Payment route
#/properties/transactionRouting.descript: CLOUD: through Adyen's cloud, needs internet. LOCAL_APP: through the Adyen Payments app on the checkout's Android device.
LOCAL_APP needs Tap to Pay filled in on: LOCAL_APP needs Tap to Pay filled in on Adyen cloud settings.
